referents.why: 'They' are the Jews named in 3:1 ('the Jew'); that people is not among the candidates (way, oracles, of God), so no candidate fits.
referents.category: referent named earlier but not offered

links.why: Gar (for) opens cl1 and gives the reason for 'much in every way': the first advantage is that they were entrusted.
links.category: reason after a claim of degree

links.why: The hoti clause does not give a reason for cl1; it states what the first advantage is.
'First, that they were entrusted': the hoti clause states the content of the point made in cl1.
links.category: that-clause as content of a stated point

cant_tell.why: the Jews of 3:1 are the intended people but are not offered as a candidate
